concepts.name: Pebble
concepts.detail: Concept A / Pebble: one compact, softly rounded pebble-shaped cream body that doubles as the head, wider than tall. A charcoal rounded-rectangle face display inset in its upper front, two mint oval eyes, a tiny warm smile. Two tiny cream mitten arms emerge at its sides; two tiny rounded feet below. One small asymmetrical mint side tab creates a distinct silhouette. Simple, iconic, cuddly, beautifully balanced.
concepts.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand / stylized-concept.
Asset type: identity concept sheet for Mochi, a calm local-first desktop learning companion for developers who use AI to build and want to understand their own work.
Create one exquisitely polished, original soft 3D clay chibi robot identity concept. Matte tactile ceramic-clay finish, warm cream body (#F7F3E8), dark graphite face display (#263339), soft mint accents (#91D5B6). Friendly and curious, restrained rather than childish. No human anatomy, no clothing, no extra props, no cables, no text, no typography, no watermark.
Composition: wide landscape transparent canvas. On the left, occupying about 65% of the width, a full-body front-three-quarter character, floating gently, every limb visible, subtle contact-free soft shadow directly beneath it. On the right, separated by generous empty space, one smaller macOS-style rounded-square app icon with pale mint background and an elegantly simplified close-up of EXACTLY this robot's face. The icon must read at very small size: two clear eyes, no text, no tiny circuit detail. Only these two elements on an otherwise genuinely transparent background; do not add a white or colored concept-board rectangle. Both elements fully contained with generous margins. Neutral studio lighting, delicate highlights and controlled shadows. Keep the same scale and presentation across the three concepts.
The character must have little hands suitable for waving, an expressive head suitable for tilting, and a soft body suitable for squash/stretch.

concepts.name: Capsule
concepts.detail: Concept B / Capsule: an oversized rounded rectangular cream head above a much smaller squishy cream body, with a charcoal pill-shaped face display and two mint oval eyes. Tiny cream mitten arms and small rounded feet, a subtle mint collar seam. No antenna. Strong head-to-body chibi proportion, 70% head and 30% body, gentle curious expression. Quiet, friendly little engineering robot.

concepts.name: Dumpling
concepts.detail: Concept C / Dumpling: a softly domed mochi-dumpling robot with a gently flattened base and little rounded side ears integrated into the cream shell. A charcoal oval face display with two mint oval eyes and a small happy smile. Tiny cream mitten hands and two small cream feet. A mint lower rim is the only accent. No food toppings, no antenna, not a blob with painted human features: distinctly a soft robot. Joyful, plump, organic silhouette.
